mission.title: Hard Time
mission.description: Eliminate Morpheus' poster crew and confiscate their materials.

phase.briefing: Hello, {player}. The renegade human, Morpheus, is plastering subversive posters across our City. This activity will not be tolerated. You will go to his last known location, eliminate anyone that you find there, and confiscate their materials.

enter.say: Morpheus' activities have been traced back to an area inside that building. Eradicate everyone inside the area and appropriate their materials. You should find a file folder, a flyer, and a package of posters.

done.say: The humans have all ceased function. Good.

objective.text: Get the Flyer from the Zion Selective Phage

done.say: That person appears to have been carrying something.
That is the Filefolder that we are looking for.

complete.say: One of the humans has escaped with the Package. Our sensors have tracked him... I will update your waypoint with his location once you have uploaded those two items at a hardline.

objective.text: Upload the Flyer at a hardline
Upload the Filefolder at a hardline

phase.briefing: One human escaped with the package. Follow the waypoint to his location and eliminate him.

enter.say: We've traced the remaining human to that building. Destroy him and retrieve the package.

done.say: That human was unusually troublesome; you have done well to eliminate him. Search his corpse for the package.
Good. Now upload the item at a hardline.

complete.say: These humans have such feeble security measures.

objective.text: Upload the Package at a hardline

mission.finish: Well done, {player}. You are proving to be a reliable resource for us.
